entities.name: Query FtsX
observations: 297 aa bacterial membrane protein with an exact full-length sequence match to curated Bacillus anthracis FtsX Q81X30.
Predicted multi-pass membrane protein; Pfam FtsX_ECD spans residues 58–164 and FtsX spans 175–293.
Curated homolog function: membrane component of the FtsEX ABC transporter complex involved in cell division and, in Bacillus, initiation of sporulation.
Predicted molecular weight 33.2 kDa and theoretical pI 9.54.

entities.name: FtsE
observations: ABC-transporter ATPase partner of FtsX; the FtsEX complex couples ATP hydrolysis to FtsX-dependent membrane signaling or transport.

entities.name: Bacterial cell division
observations: FtsX-associated biological process supported by curated homolog annotations; includes cell division, asymmetric division, and cell septum assembly.

entities.name: Bacillus sporulation initiation
observations: In Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus anthracis annotations, FtsX positively regulates sporulation initiation and acts upstream of sporulation phosphorelay components.
